name: ah-browser
description: Drive a hidden browser to automate a website task or test a web app as a user would, on hosts without a high-fidelity browser of their own. Wraps agent-browser with fleet defaults; installs nothing and stores no key.

interface.shortDescription: Automate websites and test web apps in a hidden browser.
interface.longDescription: Drive a hidden browser to automate a website task or test a web app as a user would, on hosts without a high-fidelity browser of their own. Wraps agent-browser with fleet defaults; installs nothing and stores no key.
defaultPrompt: Test this web app as a user would and report what breaks.
Open this page, fill the form and show me the result.
Check the signup flow on mobile and desktop widths.
